catalogue_leads.context_excerpt: Set in modern times in the timeless land of the gods, A Lone Red Apple is a love story that takes place on the cosmopolitan Greek island of Mykonos and the nearby, sacred island of Delos. Just as these islands are opposites, so too are the lives of Matthew, a staid and shy British professor, and Elena, a lovely Greek artist with a passionate zest for life. They meet when Matthew comes to Mykonos to teach a seminar on the love poetry of Sappho.
